Name: Farm Goals - Seasonal Challenges
Author: littlelodgegames
Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
Make everyday farming count toward something bigger.

Farm Goals adds two complementary ways to progress: permanent milestones for your long-term achievements, and customizable seasonal challenges that give each season its own set of objectives.

Work toward milestones through farming, fishing, mining, crafting, friendships, and other activities. Each milestone has multiple reward tiers, so your progress continues beyond the first achievement.

Seasonal challenges provide shorter goals with individual rewards. By default, four are selected each season from a variety of general and activity-specific objectives. Choose between Simple, Specific, or Mixed challenge styles, with Mixed enabled by default. Customize challenge categories, targets, difficulty, and rewards to suit your preferred playstyle.

Challenge targets consider your farm's progression, and installing partway through a season reduces the targets to account for the time remaining.

Open the Farm Goals menu to see your progress, rewards, and remaining time. Expand milestone headings to inspect their reward tiers. Complete every seasonal challenge to earn an additional completion bonus.

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[list=1]
[*]Install SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Download and extract the mod archive.[/*]
[*]Place the
[code]FarmGoals[/code]folder inside your Stardew Valley
[code]Mods[/code]folder.[/*]
[*]Launch the game through SMAPI.[/*]
[*]Load your save and read the introduction and seasonal challenge letters.[/*]
[/list]Open Farm Goals with [b]F9[/b] or the [b]bullseye tab on the left of the game menu[/b].

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]16 permanent milestone categories[/b] covering:
[/b][/color]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Harvesting crops and catching fish.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Shipping artisan goods and earning gold.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Breaking rocks, cooking, and crafting.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Raising animals and collecting animal products.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Building friendships and giving loved gifts.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Completing quests.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Museum donations and discovering artifacts.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Restoring Community Center rooms, including equivalent Joja progression.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]51 milestone tiers[/b] across the default milestone set.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]43 seasonal challenge types:[/b] 15 general challenges and 28 specific challenges covering crops, forage, fishing, shipping, smelting, and monster hunting.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Three challenge styles:[/b] Choose Simple, Specific, or Mixed challenges, with Mixed enabled by default.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Customizable challenge categories:[/b] Enable or disable individual challenge categories and adjust their targets.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Adjustable difficulty:[/b] Scale seasonal challenge difficulty from 0.1× to 100×.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Progression-aware selection:[/b] Certain challenges become available only once the farm has reached the relevant activities.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Scaling targets:[/b] Seasonal targets can scale with farm progression, year, and additional configurable options.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Mid-season adjustment:[/b] New challenges account for the days remaining when installed.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Varied rewards:[/b] Gold, Prize Tickets, useful items, friendship increases, and Qi Gems when eligible.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Customizable rewards:[/b] Enable or disable reward types and adjust gold amounts, reward quantities, and scaling options.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Past milestone rewards:[/b] Previously earned milestone rewards are enabled by default for new configurations and delivered together by mail. Existing players can recover missed rewards through Generic Mod Config Menu or the
[/b][/color]
[code]goals_claim_past[/code][color=#D4D4D8][b]command.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Completion bonus:[/b] Finish all seasonal challenges for an extra gold reward.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Clear progress menus:[/b] This Season and Milestones pages with progress bars and expandable details.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Introduction and seasonal letters:[/b] Learn the system and receive each season's challenge list.[/b][/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b][b]Optional Generic Mod Config Menu support:[/b] Edit all mod settings directly in-game when GMCM is installed. Manual configuration remains available.[/b][/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[list]
[*][color=#D4D4D8]Stardew Valley 1.6.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/2400]SMAPI 4.0 or later[/url], using a release compatible with your game.[/color][/*]
[*][color=#D4D4D8][b]Optional:[/b] Generic Mod Config Menu for in-game configuration. [/color][/*]
[/list][size=4][b]Notes[/b][/size]
[list]
[*]Works with new and existing saves.[/*]
[*]Previously reached milestone tiers are recognised without paying their rewards again by default. Enable
[code]PayMilestonesReachedBeforeInstall[/code]if you want those rewards.[/*]
[*]Historical crop-harvest progress starts from the game’s recorded crops shipped. Harvests are counted directly after installation.[/*]
[*]Challenge selection is consistent for each save and season; reloading does not reroll the challenges.[/*]
[*]Rewards are granted automatically when completed goals are checked.[/*]
[*][b]Prize Tickets are redeemed at the Prize Machine inside Mayor Lewis’s house.[/b][/*]
[*]Friendship rewards affect villagers your farmer already knows.[/*]
[*]Qi Gem rewards are available only after the relevant progression is unlocked.[/*]
[*]Multiplayer support is [b]host-only[/b].[/*]
[*]Progress and rewards follow the game’s saving behaviour. Quitting without saving rolls back that day.[/*]
[*]Edit
[code]config.json[/code]after the first launch. Challenge-setting changes apply when the next season’s challenges are generated.[/*]
[/list]
